chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Perform Tawaf around the House (Kaaba) seven circuits, and say during the Tawaf: 'O Allah! I ask You by Your Name by which one walks upon the surface of the water just as one walks upon the hard ground. And I ask You by Your Name by which Your Throne shakes, and I ask You by Your Name by which the feet of Your Angels shake.'

And I ask You by Your Name by which Musa (peace be upon him) called upon You from the side of Mount Tur, so You answered him and cast love upon him from Yourself. And I ask You by Your Name by which You forgave Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) whatever of his sin had preceded and whatever had followed, and You completed Your favor upon him, that You do with me such and such, whatever You please of the supplication.

And every time you reach the Door of the Kaaba, send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). And say in what is between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone: 'Our Lord! Grant us good in the world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.'
And say during the Tawaf: 'O Allah! I am needy to You, and I am fearful seeking refuge, so do not change my body nor replace my name.'
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended supplications to recite while performing Tawaf around the Kaaba?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi details the ritual supplications for Tawaf, emphasizing the power of Allah's Names through cosmic imagery, such as the trembling of the Throne and the steps of angels. It uniquely integrates historical prophetic references—specifically Musa at Mount Tur and Muhammad’s forgiveness—to ground the supplicant's plea in established divine mercy. The text also prescribes specific prayers at the Door of the Kaaba and between the Yemeni Corner and Black Stone, reflecting the Shia tradition of combining physical ritual with deep theological reflection.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Safwan Bin Yahya, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Perform Tawaaf by the House (Kaaba), seven circuits and you should be saying during the Tawaaf, ‘O Allahazwj! I ask Youazwj by Yourazwj Name by which one can walk upon the surface of the water just as one can walk upon the hard ground. And I ask Youazwj by Yourazwj Name by which Your Throne can be shaken for him. And I ask Youazwj by Yourazwj Name by which the feet of the Angels would Shake for him. And I ask You by Yourazwj Name by which Musaas supplicated to Youazwj with from the side of the (Mount) Toor, so Youazwj Answered himas and Youazwj Cast the Loved upon himas from Youazwj. And I ask Youazwj by Yourazwj Name by which were Forgiven for Muhammadsaww whatever there were from the sins (of the Shiah) which were in the past and in the future, and the Favours were Completed upon himsaww, if Youazwj could Deal with me such and such what I like from the supplication. And every time you ended up to the Door of the Kaaba, so send Blessings upon the Prophetsaww and you should be saying in what is between the Yamany corner and the Black Stone: ‘[2:201] Our Lord! Grant us good in the world and good in the Hereafter, and Save us from the Punishment of the Fire’. And say during your Tawaaf: ‘O Allahazwj! I am needy to Youazwj, and I am fearful seeker of Refuge, therefore neither Alter my body nor Replace my name’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr and Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from af-Fadf ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr and Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that one must walk seven times around the Ka £ bah. During Tawaf, one should say, ‘O Allah, I appeal before You through Your name by which one walks on water just as one walks on hard land. I appeal before You through Your name for which Your Throne vibrates. I appeal before You through Your name for which the feet of Your angels shake. I appeal before You through Your name by which Moses called You from the side of Mount Tur. You answered his call and placed on him love from Yourself. I appeal before You through Your name because of which You granted forgiveness to Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, for his past and future Dhanb (shortcomings) and completed for him Your favors, grant my so and so wishes. Ask for whatever you wish.’
After you arrive near the door of al-Ka £ bah say, £ 0 Allah, grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause).’
Between the corner of al- Yemaniy and the Black Stone say, £ Our Lord, grant us good in this world and in the next life and protect us from hellfire.’
During your Tawaf (walking around the Ka £ bah) say, £ 0 Allah, I need You and I am afraid. I seek protection. Do not change my body and do not change my name.”’
